classification.difficultyReason: Interpret each diagram to select Pythagoras or an area formula, distinguish a missing leg from a hypotenuse, and rearrange before simplifying surds or rationalising. The area cases link geometric interpretation to routine conjugate rationalisation.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in each diagram.
